task.title: Connect read-only inquiry and chat business counts
task.input: stats-core, real Inquiry/ChatConversation/ChatMessage records and existing SALES scope
task.output: stats-business: a business-source adapter for the statistics entry
task.accept: 1) Save synthetic inquiries/messages through real POST /api/inquiries and POST /api/chat/conversations, then GET /api/admin/stats with business sources and verify stable business-ID counts. Retrying the same message UUID and rejected spam do not increase counts; DTOs contain no email/body (E-62). 2) ADMIN/SALES use the existing inquiry scope for read-only queries. A statistics-query failure cannot roll back or block consultation saving; M4 never imports M6 to produce counts. Unauthenticated callers and EDITOR are refused direct business-source access (E-62, E-66).
